name: bb-plugin-makosh-remote-hub
description: Experimental SSH/RDP connection manager. Stage 1: Rust helper lifecycle and verified echo IPC over a versioned stdio protocol.
author: Mesteriis

bb.name: Remote Hub [Experimental]
bb.description: Experimental SSH/RDP connection manager. Stage 1: Rust helper lifecycle and verified echo IPC over a versioned stdio protocol.

scripts.build:helper: cargo build --release --locked --target aarch64-apple-darwin --manifest-path helper/Cargo.toml && mkdir -p bin && cp helper/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/remote-hub-helper bin/remote-hub-helper && chmod +x bin/remote-hub-helper
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.test:integration: python3 tests/integration/ssh-docker.py && REMOTE_HUB_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run tests/integration/ssh-service.test.ts
